advisory.checklist_item: - [ ] Add assertion verifying two-parent commit structure in LocalGitHost when base moved (similar to RealGitHost integration test)
evidence: tests/unit/test_local_git_host.py:332 - `await host.commit_and_push(...)` result is not captured
tests/unit/test_local_git_host.py:344-346 - only asserts patch content, not commit parents
tests/integration/test_github_real_backend.py:370 - RealGitHost test explicitly asserts `_parents(rerun, result.commit_sha) == [previous.commit_sha, moved_base]`

adapters/real/local_git_host.py:148-149 - new multi-parent logic `if await self._git('merge-base', workspace_head, head, cwd=work) != workspace_head: parents += ['-p', workspace_head]` is not directly tested
advisory.finding: The LocalGitHost test `test_publish_after_the_base_moved_keeps_the_patch_to_the_change` does not verify that the commit has two parents when the base moved, unlike the RealGitHost test `test_publish_after_the_base_moved_fast_forwards_the_branch` which explicitly asserts `_parents(rerun, result.commit_sha) == [previous.commit_sha, moved_base]`
scenarios: If the multi-parent logic in LocalGitHost were broken (e.g., condition inverted), the test would still pass as long as the patch generation happened to work
advisory.suggested_fix: Capture the result of the second `commit_and_push` call and verify `_git(repo, 'rev-list', '--parents', '-n', '1', result.commit_sha).split()[1:]` contains both the previous branch commit and the advanced base commit
